page.title: Economy Overview
page.purpose: Give the minter the state of the whole economy at a glance and make what needs a decision impossible to miss.

priorities.statement: Anything waiting on a decision is the first thing seen.
priorities.notes: A pending redemption a child is waiting on outranks every other piece of information on this page.

priorities.statement: Every holder and their balance is visible without navigating away.
Whether the economy is healthy — earning happening, redemptions settling — is readable without opening the journal.
The dashboard reports state and never editorialises about a holder's behaviour.

states.description: Economy has holders, activity and possibly pending approvals.
No token type has been minted yet; the page routes the minter to creating one.
Some panels resolved and others failed; each panel reports its own state rather than blanking the page.
Showing cached figures after a failed refresh, labelled as such.
The authenticated identity is a holder, not a minter; the minter console is not rendered.

elements.name: Waiting for you
elements.description: Count of and link to redemptions awaiting a decision.

elements.name: Holders
elements.description: Each holder with their spendable and reserved balance.

elements.name: Token types
elements.description: The types in play and their supply state.

elements.name: Review approvals
elements.description: Primary action into the approval queue.

claims.statement: Pending approvals are read before holder balances and before economy activity.
The pending-approval summary is visible without scrolling on a desktop viewport.
In the partial state each panel reports its own failure rather than blanking the whole page.
The empty state routes the minter to creating a token type rather than showing an empty console.
Holder balances are presented in a scannable tabular form with sortable columns.
